finding: Canonical identifies PostgreSQL 16.15 as the corrected Noble release for the current PostgreSQL 16 security findings.
The signed PGDG package contains PostgreSQL 16.15; PostgreSQL identifies 16.15 as the fixed release for the current PostgreSQL 16 findings through its 2026-08-13 security release.

Canonical's remaining low-priority records concern local LLVM command-line processing or Arm Cortex-M code generation; the scoped PostgreSQL JIT runtime accepts neither arbitrary LLVM bitcode nor operator-supplied LLVM CLI input.

The architecture-independent Ubuntu package uses the already reviewed source coordinate; no applicable current Canonical or upstream published security advisory was identified for this distro version.
Upstream 0.8.7 contains the corrections for CVE-2026-3172 and CVE-2026-103484; the signed PGDG ARM64 binary must resolve to this exact source version before download.
